text: Reads inst/config/tools/<tool>/schema.yaml serves versioned raw/tidy schemas . See ?Config. format intro tables schemas One tables entry per file type: pattern: PCRE regex file basename; Tool uses discover classify local files. glob: list aws s3 sync --include patterns whole key; wf_sync_patterns() collects decide sync . Usually basename pattern leading * ("\\.tool1\\.table1\\.tsv$" => ["*.tool1.table1.tsv"]). ftype picks parser: Child packages add ftypes overriding private$extra_ftypes() (named list ftype -> function(x, table_name)). versions lists every tool version column appears : Schema version V = columns whose versions contain V. schema_guess matches file’s columns right version. file splits several tables (fan-) declares one outputs entry per table, versioned tidy columns (raw output parsed straight section file). tidy_<table>() returns one tibble per output; Tool checks exactly declared outputs, matching columns (order) types one schema version. shape: 'subset' allows subset columns order. output written <tool>_<output>, e.g. Tool1’s table7 => table7main + table7dp. tables: Tool1 patterns.
